content:
maya: PR #4521 updating SDK v2 snippets is blocked in GH UI: "merge blocked: required checks not met" — it also says CODEOWNERS review required but docs-preview hasn't reported. Anyone seen this race before?
sam: Did CODEOWNERS change recently? can you paste the relevant line?
maya: It's currently: `/docs/** @docs-team` (added last month).
kevin: That broad pattern will route a lot of small edits to the whole team. Two mechanics to watch: (1) branch protection can require status checks (e.g., docs-preview) separate from CODEOWNERS reviews; if preview isn't listed there, auto-merge flags will still block. (2) GH sometimes delays the check context name if the runner posts a different label.
ci-bot: CI: docs-preview started for PR #4521 (run id: 992). Result: FAILED — link-check (2 broken), markdown-lint (1 warning).
maya: I'll dig into the broken links; one is an external redirect, one is a bad anchor.
sam: For unblocking, options: (A) make docs-preview a required status in branch protection (needs repo-admin), (B) add a short-lived GH Action that auto-approves when label `docs-ready` is applied and docs-preview passes, or (C) narrow CODEOWNERS so trivial edits don't need full team signoff.
kevin: Example auto-approve action (trimmed):
```yaml
name: docs-auto-approve
on: pull_request_target:
  types: [labeled]
jobs:
  approve:
    if: contains(github.event.label.name, 'docs-ready')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: hmarr/auto-approve-action@v2
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
kevin: Caveat: this posts an approval as the action runner. CODEOWNERS still enforces who must approve; the bot must be allowed to approve or the rule still blocks.
ops-bot: ops: note that auto-approvals are allowed only for service accounts in our policies. We can create `docs-ci-bot` with limited scope if needed — requires Ops OK.
maya: I'd rather not monkey with CODEOWNERS today. I'll fix the links and push. If CI passes, can one of you approve?
sam: Also: double-check the check context name from the preview job. We had a mismatch last week where the action reported `docs-preview/legacy` vs the branch protection expecting `docs-preview`.
ci-bot: Updated: rerun complete for commit xyz789 — docs-preview: PASSED (link-check OK), markdown-lint: WARNING only.
kevin: Reviewing now. If all good, I'll leave an approval.
maya: Thanks. FYI I'm going to open a follow-up to propose splitting CODEOWNERS into `/docs/snippets/** @docs-team` and `/docs/guides/** @tech-writers` to reduce blast radius. Will ping platform-ops for gating that change.
sam: +1 on splitting, but let's coordinate with security/ops first.
ops-bot: ops: replied to sam's comment — will review proposed CODEOWNERS edit in next ops sync. We'll prefer adding `docs-ci-bot` as CODEOWNER over broad team changes if immediate unblock needed.
kevin: Approved and merging once checks complete. Maya — thanks for quick fix.
maya: Appreciated! Leaving the follow-up proposal and tagging ops in the PR thread.
